text:
Diane: quick sync — product wants a 'correlation pulse' card in Console. Need runtime + infra inputs: which headers we rely on, span vs trace behavior, sampling defaults, metric tags, and what we can expose in rollout UI. Ping runtime/infra to provide constraints by EOD.

Ashwin: runtime: we emit X-RW-Trace and X-RW-Span. Prefer clients send W3C `traceparent` too. KV cache means short-circuit responses may not create a server span. We'll add header when we create a server span.

Kevin: platform: Console needs a stable correlation id to join logs/metrics. If clients don't send one, edge will generate rw_cid and we should propagate it. Need agreement on header name and 128-bit format (hex pref).

Maria: eng-sre: sampling proposal — default reservoir 0.5% for successes, 100% for 5xx/errors. Allow per-customer override. We need a `rw_sampled` flag in logs (1/0) and a `rw_sample_rate` metric.

Sam: product: for rollout UX we want a sampled toggle and side-by-side panels for sampled vs full request latency so teams can see sampling bias. Also show per-route quota usage and fallback model chosen when a route is throttled.

Hiro: eng-infra: telemetry ingestion — add `corr_id` dimension for traces/metrics but watch cardinality. We'll roll up by route+region for dashboards and only keep full per-request indices for one week.

Ashwin: runtime follow-up: propose header `X-RW-CID` (uuid4) injected at edge; propagate as gRPC metadata `x-rw-cid`. Also keep `X-RW-SAMPLED:1/0` on forwarded requests.

Diane: ok can we get a concrete list of headers + flags and an example metric tag set by EOD? I'll create a Console mock and link it in the ticket.

deploy-bot: new ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4821 — attach runtime + infra checklists.

Kevin: also propose route-level quota metrics: `tokens_per_minute` and `concurrent_requests`. Expose both in Console to guide canary throttles.

Maria: note: when sampling on errors, ensure alerts reference sampled traces too (don't rely only on logs). Add alert runbook pointer.

Sam: UX note: show 'sampling bias' warning if effective sampled rate < 0.1% for a route.

Hiro: will open telemetry pipeline PR; ETA tomorrow morning.

Diane: thanks everyone. If you can't hit EOD, drop a thumbs up or assign in the ticket. :thumbsup:
